title: Comet - Private Deployment Weekly Sync (2026-11-02)
content:
Prep notes for weekly sync with Comet (private deployment, VPC/on-prem) - 2026-11-02

Context: Customer Comet is on private deployment track (VPC + on-prem burst nodes). Goal for Q4: complete network & security gating, finalize automated deploys, and run first load test in staging (target 2026-11-15). This doc is a lightweight working agenda + current-state notes and blockers.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m quick status / highlights
- 10m network & security (VPC peering, subnets, firewall rules)
- 10m deployment pipeline (infra-as-code, image signing, runbooks)
- 5m next steps & owners

Status summary (short):
- VPC peering requested and provisioned in Comet account; awaiting route table updates. (Samir owns)
- On-prem edge nodes: hardware arrived to Comet data center; OS image baseline validated. (Elena owns)
- Deployment pipeline: initial terraform + kustomize templates in repo; image signing stubbed but not wired into CI. (Tom owns)
- Security: Comet Sec team requested HSM/KMS integration and audit log format examples. (Priya looped in)

Milestones / timeline (target dates):
- 2026-11-05: Route table updates and firewall rule exceptions applied (blocking for staging traffic).
- 2026-11-08: CI image signing integrated + canary deploy run on staging cluster.
- 2026-11-12: End-to-end smoke tests passing on staging (basic latency/correctness).
- 2026-11-15: First scaled load test (target 500 concurrent sessions) in staging.

Current blockers (priority order):
1) Firewall rules & routing: Comet network team needs exact ingress source CIDR and port list from us to open on their side. Without that, peering exists but traffic is dropped. Root cause: we sent a high-level list; Comet needs concrete per-service rules.
   - Proposed immediate fix: Send per-service port/CIDR table by EOD 2026-11-02.
   - Owner: Samir (action item below).
2) Image signing in CI: Signing service endpoint credentials not yet provisioned in Comet vault (KMS/HSM onboarding in progress). Without signing, policy blocks deploys to on-prem.
   - Temporary workaround: allow unsigned images for canary only with manual approval (limited window).
   - Owner: Tom + Comet Sec (Priya).
3) Observability configuration: Logs/metrics export format mismatch with Comet SIEM (fields and timezone). Need mapping doc and example events.
   - Owner: Elena + Comet Sec.

Discussion points to raise:
- Confirm whether Comet will accept our egress NAT IPs for license checks or they prefer outbound via their existing NAT. Need decision this week.
- Clarify SLA expectations for on-prem fallback (what is acceptable RTO/RPO for Comet apps).
- Decide on automation scope for firewall updates: manual change request vs. terraform-managed in Comet account.

Notes for meeting:
- Bring concrete port table: {control plane, inference, metrics, healthcheck}. Be explicit about UDP/TCP and ports.
- Show quick demo of image signing workflow in local env and explain minimal steps to wire into Comet CI.
- Ask Comet PM for a single point of contact for change approvals during the 11/8-11/15 window.

Risks: 
- If KMS provisioning slips >1 week, signed-image gating will push the first load test by >7 days.
- Manual firewall changes during high-load run risks inconsistency; recommend error budget to prevent mid-test config changes.

Decision needed by EOD 2026-11-03: whether to proceed with canary using unsigned images (manual approval) or delay until signing is live.

Reference notes / logs:
- last peering ticket: PD-789 (see linked_artifacts)
- sample audit log format (attached in Confluence page)
action_items: Samir: Compile and send per-service port/CIDR table to Comet network team by EOD 2026-11-02.
Tom: Provision temporary manual-approval canary run instructions and gate for 2026-11-08; include rollback steps (due 2026-11-04).
Elena: Produce observability field mapping doc and 3 example events for Comet SIEM (due 2026-11-06).
Priya (Comet Sec): Confirm HSM/KMS onboarding ETA and share credential provisioning checklist (by 2026-11-03).
Maya: Schedule emergency sync with Comet PM if image signing ETA slips past 2026-11-05; propose contingency plan.
